svg.title: frameproof: frame-level performance evidence for web apps, built for coding agents. One scroll at 4x CPU, frame by frame: 35 late before the fix, 0 after.
svg.text: Frame-level performance evidence for web apps, built to be used by coding agents.
Real Chrome, real GPU, out of sight
35 late of 112 · a layout forced on every scroll event
0 late of 112 · reads and writes batched once a frame
One scroll of the sample app, every frame Chrome meant to show; red ones arrived late. Measured, not drawn: 2020 Intel MacBook, Chrome 156.
